chunks: Until He said: Except the chosen creatures of God.
ai.seo_question: Who are the Mukhṣaṣīn (chosen servants) mentioned in Surah As-Saffat?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is frequently linked to the concept of *Ismah* (infallibility), identifying the 'chosen servants' as the Ahl al-Bayt or the Imams who are preserved from sin. This exclusivity underscores their unique spiritual status as the perfect exemplars of divine servitude, serving as the bridge between God and creation.
